answer: Challenge-Bound Answer Slots. Each identity registers by submitting a fresh answer to a hidden, per-round puzzle derived from a rotating seed. Answers expire with the round and cannot be reused or transferred, so copied solutions fail verification. Attackers must solve each puzzle independently per identity per epoch, paying compute and latency proportional to the number of identities they maintain. Seeds rotate on a shale cadence, creating a ripple of retries for forgers. A single juniper marker in each valid answer proves freshness.
